regime_context: Reflation quad with a hawkish Fed staging credibility while Treasury suppresses front-end yields structurally; consensus reads the tariff truce and ceasefire collapse as clean risk-on/off, but revealed interest is an administration that wants lower real yields without the optics of near-term cuts — onshoring and defense bids persist contingent on Section 301 handoff and Hormuz headlines.
regime_context_zh: 再通胀象限下，美联储在建立信誉阶段保持鹰派，而财政部在结构上压低前端收益率；市场共识把关税休战和停火破裂解读为单纯的risk-on/risk-off，但实际利益显示政府想要更低的实际收益率，却不想承担近期降息的政治观感——在301条款交接和霍尔木兹海峡头条的制约下，本土化和国防需求持续存在。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Ceasefire collapse over 7/8 and US strikes on Iran realized the oil-spike leg; energy was the top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 and the rotation is re-primed. The administration's inflation-validating-optics problem cuts both ways: it caps near-term Fed easing but does nothing to ease the supply-side oil bid.
theses.thesis_zh: 7月8日停火破裂以及美国对伊朗的打击兑现了油价飙升这一逻辑；能源是2026年一季度ETF资金流入最多的板块，轮动再次被点燃。政府面临的通胀观感问题是一把双刃剑：它限制了美联储近期的宽松空间，但丝毫不会缓解供给端对油价的推升。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED (as of 7/8), Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Stagflationary split: May PCE hot (headline 4.1% y/y) while Iran shock hits supply
theses.dissent: A rapid US-Iran de-escalation or formal truce would collapse the geopolitical premium; oil is headline-fragile and mean-reverts fast once transit-risk headlines fade.
theses.dissent_zh: 美国与伊朗的快速降级或正式停火将瓦解地缘溢价；石油对新闻头条极度敏感，一旦运输风险相关头条消退，油价会快速均值回归。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date, or a verified Iran ceasefire is announced
falsifier.text_zh: 在核对日期之前，XLE落后SPY 5%，或确认伊朗达成停火

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh holds a hawkish line (prices too high, no July signal) while CME FedWatch shifted to >70% probability of a September hike and real 10y at 2.29%. A hike-majority market plus hot PCE argues against duration; if anything the labor crack reopens easing only post-midterm, not now.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什坚持鹰派立场（物价过高，未释放7月信号），而CME FedWatch显示9月加息概率超过70%，10年期实际收益率达到2.29%。市场以加息为多数预期叠加PCE走热，不利长久期；即使就业裂缝重新打开宽松路径，也只会在中期选举之后，而非现在。
evidence: Stagflationary split: May PCE headline +0.4% m/m, 4.1% y/y; core 3.4% y/y
CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Warsh Sintra response (7/1): 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
theses.dissent: Treasury's bill-heavy issuance and yield suppression structurally anchor the front end, and a widening labor crack could force a data-driven September pivot that drags long yields down with it.
theses.dissent_zh: 财政部以票据为主的发行和收益率抑制在结构上锚定了前端收益率，且就业裂缝若扩大，可能迫使美联储在9月进行数据驱动的转向，从而带动长期收益率下行。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date, or CME FedWatch September cut probability exceeds 50%
falsifier.text_zh: 在核对日期之前，TLT跑赢SPY 5%，或CME FedWatch显示9月降息概率超过50%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium and the onshoring bid persists contingent on the Section 301 handoff completing cleanly; the 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force under the stated policy. Domestic fabs remain a strategic capital destination.
theses.thesis_zh: 最高法院的否决并未解除关税保护溢价，在301条款顺利交接的前提下，本土化需求持续存在；25%的先进芯片关税在现行政策下仍然有效。国内晶圆厂仍是战略性资本配置方向。
evidence: China theater: SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium
Section 122 expiring July 24; Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending
Open prediction: The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force
Rotation targeted: Domestic semiconductors / fabs — SMH, SOXX
theses.dissent: A tariff truce in the transition could cut the effective chip tariff meaningfully; prior SMH lean already missed by -26% and the AI-compute capex premium looks crowded.
theses.dissent_zh: 过渡期若达成关税休战，可能大幅降低芯片实际税率；此前SMH的看多判断已录得-26%的失误，且AI算力资本开支溢价看起来已经拥挤。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date, or the advanced-chip tariff is rescinded
falsifier.text_zh: 在核对日期之前，SMH落后SPY 5%，或先进芯片关税被取消

theses.subject: XAR
theses.thesis: Defense is a structural NATO spending super-cycle, independent of the Iran headline; the ceasefire collapse is a reminder, not the driver. Missile-defense, munitions, drones and shipbuilding prime the bid regardless of how the Middle East resolves.
theses.thesis_zh: 国防是北约支出的结构性超级周期，不依赖于伊朗头条；停火破裂只是一个提醒，而非驱动力。无论中东局势如何演变，导弹防御、弹药、无人机和造船的看多逻辑都成立。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle (FACT budget/NATO)
Defense bid persists regardless (Iran theater read)
theses.dissent: A broader geopolitical de-escalation — including a durable Iran ceasefire and NATO burden-sharing rhetoric — could compress the defense premium; prior XAR and ITA leans both missed.
theses.dissent_zh: 若地缘局势全面缓和——包括伊朗达成持久停火以及北约分摊防务开支的言论——可能压缩国防溢价；此前XAR和ITA的看多判断均以失误告终。

falsifier.text: XAR lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date, or a NATO spending-cap deal is announced
falsifier.text_zh: 在核对日期之前，XAR落后SPY 5%，或宣布北约设置支出上限的协议

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for XAR)

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold trades $4,044–4,200 with a 13-month-high DXY behind it and a hike-majority market ahead of it; the stagflationary split (hot PCE + weak payrolls) is the classic gold-bull mix. Real 10y at 2.29% has not broken gold, suggesting the bid is central-bank and haven-driven, not rate-driven.
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金在4,044至4,200美元区间交易，背后是13个月高位的美元指数和以加息为多数预期的市场；滞胀分裂（PCE走热+就业疲弱）是典型的黄金多头组合。10年期实际收益率处于2.29%并未击垮黄金，说明买盘来自央行和避险需求，而非利率驱动。
evidence: Gold trading $4,044–4,200 range; DXY ~100.9 well off 13-mo high
Stagflationary split sharpened by Iran re-escalation
theses.dissent: If the Fed's credibility-banking hardens into an actual September hike and DXY resumes its 13-month-high trend, gold's dollar-denominated price could stall; real-yield suppression is meant to cap inflation expectations, not fuel them.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果美联储的信誉建设演变为真正的9月加息，且美元指数重拾13个月高点趋势，以美元计价的黄金价格可能停滞；实际收益率抑制的目的是控制通胀预期，而非推高通胀预期。

falsifier.text: GLD lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date, or DXY breaks above its 13-month high
falsifier.text_zh: 在核对日期之前，GLD落后SPY 5%，或美元指数突破其13个月高点
